title.value: Control a PC for small tasks with ChatGPT

introduction.value: A user has ChatGPT control their PC to install game mods, update apps, do color correction in DaVinci, and organize files, and asks whether Gemini can do the same.

method.value: The poster says they already use ChatGPT to control a Windows PC for small jobs: installing game mods, handling manual app updates, doing light color correction in DaVinci, and organizing files. In the comments, people describe this as either the model giving PowerShell or step-by-step instructions for the user to run, or, on Gemini’s side, working through its own browser or sandbox rather than directly controlling the whole desktop.

outcome.value: The thread reports mixed results rather than a measured outcome: several commenters say Gemini can handle command-line help and small tasks, but is less polished than ChatGPT for multi-step PC control and lacks true desktop-wide computer use.

notes.value: One practical catch mentioned is that Gemini users may need extras like Antigravity, and one commenter suggests planning the whole task in AI Studio first to stretch usage limits.

source_text.body:
Control a PC for small tasks with ChatGPT
A user has ChatGPT control their PC to install game mods, update apps, do color correction in DaVinci, and organize files, and asks whether Gemini can do the same.
Done with
GP
ChatGPT
GE
Gemini
What they did
The poster says they already use ChatGPT to control a Windows PC for small jobs: installing game mods, handling manual app updates, doing light color correction in DaVinci, and organizing files. In the comments, people describe this as either the model giving PowerShell or step-by-step instructions for the user to run, or, on Gemini’s side, working through its own browser or sandbox rather than directly controlling the whole desktop.
How it went
The thread reports mixed results rather than a measured outcome: several commenters say Gemini can handle command-line help and small tasks, but is less polished than ChatGPT for multi-step PC control and lacks true desktop-wide computer use.
Worth knowing
One practical catch mentioned is that Gemini users may need extras like Antigravity, and one commenter suggests planning the whole task in AI Studio first to stretch usage limits.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT
Copy prompt
Take control of my computer and handle these small tasks one at a time: [task 1, e.g. install mods for a game], [task 2, e.g. update my outdated apps], [task 3, e.g. organize my Downloads folder by file type]. Tell me what you plan to do before each task and narrate as you go. Pause and ask me before deleting any files, running installers from unfamiliar sources, or changing system settings, and finish with a short list of what was done and anything that needs my attention.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GeminiAI/comments/1y3mc92/is_gemini_computer_use_as_good_as_chatgpt
